'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 2 Tom H DS Hoth''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tom H]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth (Dark)|Hoth-D-hoth.gif|label=Hoth}}
* '''Deck name:''' Cole's deck
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
